profile.headline: Sr. Staff Software Engineer at Google

positions.title: uPortal Framework Technologist
positions.description:
The focus of this position is on supporting the "My UW-Madison" uPortal framework. This includes providing technical expertise and leadership in designing, executing, and managing the development of new applications within the uPortal framework. This position is responsible for test frameworks, development and support. These components operate on multiple Unix and Windows servers, are web based, use advance Layer 4 networking, interoperate with LDAP directory systems, and use Java and XML technologies.

This position also plays a major role in developing and implementing policies, standards, and guidelines used within the portal system. This position will provide technical leadership and will work as a senior technical expert in the areas of portal framework, web application servers, system logging, system statistics, interface design, and supporting the deployment of enterprise-wide J2EE applications in a portal framework.

positions.description: Provided Java and web development services for the Administrative Computing Services department.

projects.title: uMobile
projects.description: uMobile is an international open source initiative to bring campus applications, content, and data to mobile devices. The project provides a native app for iPhone and Android devices, as well as browser-based content for other smartphones.

projects.title: uPortal
projects.description: uPortal is the leading open source enterprise portal framework built by and for the higher education community.  uPortal continues to evolve through contributions from its global community and is supported by resources, grants, donations, and memberships fees from academic institutions, commercial affiliates, and non-profit foundations.
